statement: Line tool draws edges by click-click or click-drag with live length, axis coloring and typed length or coordinates; closing a coplanar loop auto-creates a face.
superiority: Face creation is explainable (shows why a loop did or did not become a face) and offers auto-repair of near-coplanar loops.

acceptance.sketch: Draw 12 scripted lines forming a planar loop; edges exist with exact lengths, one face created, normal matches right-hand rule.

statement: Drawing a line across an existing face splits it into faces; drawing across existing edges inserts vertices at crossings.
superiority: Split results keep face attributes and materials with a visible report.

acceptance.sketch: Draw a line across a rectangle: two faces whose areas sum to the original within 1e-9.

statement: Freehand tool draws a curve from a drag path, creating a curve entity (many short edges) that can be closed into a face.
superiority: Fits editable splines to the stroke instead of dense edge chains.

acceptance.sketch: Replay a 200-point path; resulting curve vertex positions equal the path within pick tolerance and the curve is a single selectable curve entity.

statement: Rectangle tool creates a rectangular face from two corner clicks with typed dimensions such as 3,4 and inferred drawing plane.
superiority: Rectangles remain parametric (editable size) until exploded.

acceptance.sketch: Draw 2m by 3m on the ground plane; one face, area 6.0 m2 within 1e-12 relative.

statement: Rotated Rectangle draws a rectangle at any angle in any plane by defining base edge, plane and then side.
superiority: Same parametric editability as rectangle.

acceptance.sketch: Specify base edge, tilt 30 degrees and width; the result corners match closed-form coordinates within 1e-9.

statement: Circle tool creates a segmented circle face with typed radius and segment count (arrow keys or Ctrl +/-), reported as a circle entity with center inference.
superiority: True analytic circle option with adaptive tessellation instead of fixed segments.

acceptance.sketch: Circle r=1 with 24 segments: vertices lie on the radius within 1e-12, segments=24, face area equals the polygon area.

statement: Polygon tool creates regular polygons with typed side count and radius, inscribed or circumscribed to the typed radius.
superiority: Same plus polygon editing handles.

acceptance.sketch: Hexagon r=2 inscribed: side length 2.0 within 1e-12.

statement: Pie tool creates a closed circular sector (arc plus two radii) with typed radius, angle and segments.
superiority: Analytic sector with exact area.

acceptance.sketch: Pie r=1, 90 degrees, 12 segments: sector area within polygon tolerance; closed face.

statement: Arc tool defines center, start point and sweep angle with typed radius, angle and segments.
superiority: Exact conic arcs with true arc entity continuity.

acceptance.sketch: Arc r=1.5 sweep 60 degrees; end point equals closed form within 1e-12.

statement: 2-Point Arc defines chord ends then a bulge by dragging or typing a bulge distance, with arc-through-tangent inference.
superiority: Bulge handle editable after creation.

acceptance.sketch: Chord 2, bulge 0.5; computed radius equals (c^2/8b + b/2) within 1e-12.

statement: 3-Point Arc draws an arc through a pivot start and two end points.
superiority: Handles degenerate collinear input with a diagnostic.

acceptance.sketch: Arc through three given points; circumcenter and radius match closed form within 1e-9.

statement: Starting an arc from the endpoint of an edge or arc offers a tangent arc continuation, flagged with a tangent inference.
superiority: Chain of tangent arcs with a G2 continuity option.

acceptance.sketch: Start from endpoint of a line and drag; the tangent direction at the join equals the line direction within 1e-9.

statement: Arcs with three or more segments remain arc entities that can be edited by radius and segment count in Entity Info.
superiority: Arc remains analytic and re-tessellates in any LOD.

acceptance.sketch: Edit arc segments from 12 to 24 in Entity Info; vertex count updates and radius stays unchanged.

statement: Default segment counts per shape are set by tool, and arrow or Ctrl+/- adjusts them while drawing.

source.ref: Circle and arc segment count default and live adjust

superiority: Chordal-error based tessellation target instead of fixed segment counts.

acceptance.sketch: Press the increase key 4 times; segment count increases by 4; value shown in Measurements box.

statement: Eraser erases entities by click or drag; Shift hides, Ctrl smooths, Ctrl+Shift un-softens, and erasing an edge removes adjacent faces.
superiority: Erase preview highlights exactly which dependents will be removed.

acceptance.sketch: Erase one edge of a cube: edge and its two faces are removed; Shift-erase leaves it hidden; undo restores in one step.

statement: Single-level toolbar and keyboard undo/redo with each tool operation as one step.
superiority: Branching undo with disk spill and unlimited depth.

acceptance.sketch: Perform 100 operations then undo all; model hash equals the initial hash.

statement: Tape Measure creates infinite and finite guide lines parallel to edges or at given distance, with typed offset and Ctrl to toggle creation.
superiority: Guides are named, lockable constraint objects.

acceptance.sketch: Create a guide 2.5 m from an edge; guide direction parallel, distance exact within 1e-9.

statement: Tape Measure has a Create Guide Point mode that places a standalone guide point at a typed distance from a reference point, double-click makes a point at the cursor.
superiority: Guide points can be driven by parameters.

acceptance.sketch: Place a point 1.2 m from a vertex along a locked axis; position exact within 1e-9.

statement: Tape Measure re-scales the whole model or selected group by measuring a known distance and typing the real value.

source.ref: Tape Measure resize model by scale

superiority: Re-scale with a preview and a unit-checked confirmation.

acceptance.sketch: Measure a 2 m edge, type 4 m; all geometry doubles, scale factor 2.0 within 1e-12.

statement: Edit menu can delete all guides and View can hide them.
superiority: Selective guide deletion by tag or named set.

acceptance.sketch: Create 10 guides, Delete Guides; none remain and undo restores them.

statement: Protractor measures angles and creates angled guide lines through a vertex with typed angle.
superiority: Angle guides lockable and parametric.

acceptance.sketch: Create a guide at 37.5 degrees; angle matches to 1e-9 radian.

statement: Dimension tool adds associative linear, radius and diameter annotations to edges, arcs and vertices with typed offset and leaders.
superiority: Dimensions are driving constraints, not only annotations.

acceptance.sketch: Dimension between two vertices; text equals distance to 1e-6 in current units; moving a vertex updates the text.

statement: Text tool places leader text anchored to geometry or screen-fixed text with auto-filled entity info (area, length, coordinates).
superiority: Text fields bind live to attributes and classification data.

acceptance.sketch: Label a face with area; text equals face area in current units within display rounding.

statement: 3D Text tool creates extruded or flat glyph geometry with font, height and extrusion settings as a group.
superiority: Real font outlines as editable curves with OpenType features.

acceptance.sketch: Create text "A1" with height 100 mm and extrusion 10 mm; bounding box height 100 mm within font metric tolerance.

statement: Axes tool repositions and rotates the model drawing axes, with context-menu Place Axes and Reset.
superiority: Multiple saved axes sets.

acceptance.sketch: Place axes at a vertex rotated 15 degrees; all subsequent inferences use the new frame.

statement: Section Plane creates cutting planes with active/inactive state, display of plane, cut and fill, reverse and align view; cuts affect all geometry.
superiority: Section planes can be multi-segment and dynamic with live area readouts.

acceptance.sketch: Cut a cube with a plane at mid height; section view shows 50 percent of volume, cut edges on the plane within 1e-9.

statement: Display Section Plane, Display Section Cut and Display Section Fill toggle each part of a section independently with fill color.
superiority: Section fill obeys hatch patterns and material layers.

acceptance.sketch: Toggle each of the three; render output differs accordingly with fill color matching the style.

statement: Click, double-click (face plus edges), triple-click (connected geometry), left-to-right window and right-to-left crossing selection, Shift toggles and Ctrl adds.

source.ref: Select tool basics (click, drag window, crossing, Shift, Ctrl)

superiority: Selection sets can be named, saved and combined with boolean operators.

acceptance.sketch: Script each gesture on a fixture; selected entity sets equal expected sets exactly.

statement: Lasso freehand selection tool selects geometry fully or partially inside a drawn loop.
superiority: Lasso supports additive and subtractive modes with a preview.

acceptance.sketch: Lasso around 3 of 10 objects; exactly those 3 selected.

statement: Context menu Select > Connected Faces, All Connected, Bounding Edges, All with Same Material, All with Same Tag.

source.ref: Select by context (connected, bounding edges, faces, all with material/layer)

superiority: Query-by-attribute selection with saved filters.

acceptance.sketch: Selection counts equal expected set on fixture for each option.

statement: Edit menu and context menu Select All and Invert Selection.
superiority: Invert within the active context only.

acceptance.sketch: Invert yields the exact complement of the prior selection.

statement: Paint Bucket applies materials to faces, groups and components; modifiers fill all connected, replace material everywhere, or fill matching adjacent faces; painting also works outside predefined Live Component options.

source.ref: Paint Bucket (fill, replace, adjacent, material filters)

superiority: Paint with material layers, with undo of per-face assignments.

acceptance.sketch: Paint 6 faces with modifiers; the set of faces with new material equals expected set.

statement: Navigation by mouse, touchpad and keyboard: orbit, pan, zoom, zoom window, zoom extents, previous view.
superiority: Orbit around a pickable pivot with inertia options and 3D mouse support.

acceptance.sketch: Replay navigation script; camera matrices equal reference within 1e-9.

statement: Position Camera places eye at a point at a typed eye height; Look Around rotates the view in place.
superiority: Camera constraint by walkable surface.

acceptance.sketch: Place camera at eye height 1.6 m at a point; camera eye z equals 1.6 m.

statement: Walk tool navigates the model with collision and gravity options, eye height and keyboard modifiers.
superiority: Walk with real physics character controller and stairs.

acceptance.sketch: Walk along a corridor fixture; camera path follows ground height and collides with a wall.

statement: Match Photo aligns the camera with a photo using vanishing-point axes and then projects the photo onto the model as a texture.
superiority: Automatic vanishing-line detection and lens distortion calibration.

acceptance.sketch: Reference photo of a box with 3 vanishing lines; recovered camera focal length within 2 percent of the known value.

statement: Camera menu selects perspective, parallel, two-point perspective, FOV or focal length and image aspect.

source.ref: Perspective, parallel projection, two-point perspective and field of view

superiority: Orthographic with true scale readout.

acceptance.sketch: Set FOV 35 degrees; projection matrix matches closed form.

statement: Iso, Top, Front, Right, Back, Left and Bottom views with Zoom Extents and Undo Previous Camera.
superiority: View cube for direct orientation.

acceptance.sketch: Each standard view yields the exact axis-aligned camera.

statement: Hide and Unhide for entities with display toggles for hidden geometry and hidden objects.

source.ref: Hide, Unhide, Hidden Geometry and Hidden Objects display

superiority: Hide state per scene.

acceptance.sketch: Hide a face and set hidden display; the face renders as mesh when toggled, otherwise invisible.

statement: Soften Edges panel sets an angle threshold to soften or smooth edges, hide soft edges, and smooth normals for curved shading.

source.ref: Soften and smooth edges (Soften Edges panel)

superiority: Per-vertex normal editing and auto-smooth angle presets.

acceptance.sketch: Soften a 24-segment cylinder at 20 degrees; side edges soft, caps hard; shading normals smooth.

statement: Intersect Faces creates edges where selected faces cross other geometry in the model, selection or context.

source.ref: Intersect Faces (with model, with selection, with context)

superiority: Booleans on faces produce clean topology without stray edges.

acceptance.sketch: Two crossing boxes: intersection edges match analytic intersection within 1e-9.

statement: Divide edge into equal segments; Split; Explode Curve; Weld; Reverse faces; Align face.

source.ref: Divide, split and explode edges, curves and faces

superiority: Divide by distance, count or pattern.

acceptance.sketch: Divide a 3 m edge into 5; 5 edges of 0.6 m within 1e-12.

statement: Faces have front and back sides with distinct style colors; Reverse Faces and Orient Faces flip normals consistently.

source.ref: Face orientation (front and back) and Reverse Faces

superiority: Face orientation analysis and auto-fix for closed solids.

acceptance.sketch: Orient a connected 20-face set; all normals consistent with the picked face.

statement: Weld joins connected edges into a single curve entity (polyline).
superiority: Welded curves convert to splines.

acceptance.sketch: Weld 5 edges; one curve entity with 5 segments.

statement: Drawing across or erasing edges can heal deleted faces; coplanar faces merge when the shared edge is erased.

source.ref: Fix broken faces, stray edges and coplanar healing

superiority: Reports geometry anomalies on import.

acceptance.sketch: Erase shared edge between coplanar faces: one merged face; area equals sum.
